summary: Invoke the private-data scanner for dispatched checks
body: For runs against ordinary external projects, this only passes a detections-log path to the project’s declared checks; `runChecks` never invokes the pinned `scrub-check.sh` or `tree-check.sh`. Unless the target’s own gate independently calls these scripts, no findings are recorded and private data can pass through the new TELL and ship-card flow. Run the pinned scanner as a mandatory check on the target worktree.

summary: Decode UTF-16 before scanning Git child output
body: When a changed committed file is UTF-16LE or UTF-16BE, Git’s diff output contains NUL-interleaved bytes, but `childLines` decodes them only as UTF-8. The range scan therefore misses text that the `--files` mode correctly detects from a BOM-marked file, allowing such findings to pass the gate; the raw-blob scan has the same issue. Detect the encoding or scan the blob through the BOM-aware reader before feeding lines to the scanner.
